title: Tech Program / Project Manager
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Surfscan® division develops unpatterned wafer inspection systems that detect nanoscale particles and surface defects early in semiconductor manufacturing. Its systems monitor wafer quality across a wide range of applications, enabling faster issue identification and improved process control.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Program leadership:** Own the integrated program plan from definition through delivery, including scope, milestones, dependencies, critical path, decision points, and measurable outcomes.

* **Cross-functional execution:** Align software, systems, electrical, algorithms, applications, and hardware teams around priorities, commitments, and release readiness.

* **Product integration:** Coordinate integration across High-Performance Computing (HPC) software, tool software, hardware, and processing workflows to deliver a reliable bench solution.

* **Risk and issue management:** Identify technical, schedule, resource, and operational risks early; drive mitigation, escalation, and replanning when conditions change.

* **Product lifecycle governance:** Lead the team through KLA's Product Lifecycle process, ensuring plans, evidence, risks, and cross-functional readiness are clear at key decision points.

* **Release and operational readiness:** Partner with marketing, supply chain, manufacturing, install, and service teams to prepare solutions for deployment, support, and scale.

* **Customer readiness:** Work with marketing and global customers to understand operating environments and define site-preparation and IT requirements that support successful product adoption.

* **Executive communication:** Use relevant metrics and concise, objective updates to communicate progress, decisions, trade-offs, risks, and business impact.

* **Team leadership:** Build strong working relationships, encourage ownership, resolve ambiguity, and influence multidisciplinary teams without relying on direct authority.

  
  

**What You Bring**
==================

* Experience leading complex technical programs or new-product development from concept through integration, release, and customer adoption.

* Strong understanding of product architectures that combine software, computing infrastructure, hardware, processing workflows, and real-time analysis.

* Demonstrated ability to build and manage integrated schedules, dependencies, critical paths, risks, and mitigation plans.

* Technical judgment to ask the right questions, evaluate trade-offs, and ensure plans address performance, reliability, cost, manufacturability, and serviceability.

* Ability to translate business goals and customer needs into clear program priorities and execution plans.

* Strong leadership, critical thinking, problem-solving, collaboration, and written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience using meaningful indicators to communicate progress, readiness, quality, and program impact.

* Working knowledge of Agile, iterative, and waterfall development approaches, with the judgment to apply the right method to the work.

  
  

**Preferred Experience**
========================

* Semiconductor equipment, industrial systems, scientific instrumentation, or another complex hardware-software product environment.

* Customer engagement, feedback analysis, deployment readiness, or product adoption planning.

* HPC platforms, data processing pipelines, software release systems, digital twins, replay or simulation environments.

Formal program or project management practices and tools; a PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent credential is helpful but not required.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Doctorate degree with at least 5 years of relevant experience; or

* Master's degree with at least 8 years of relevant experience; or

* Bachelor's degree with at least 10 years of relevant experience.

Relevant experience may come from technical program management, project management, systems engineering, product development, software or hardware delivery, or a closely related field.

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  
  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

Based in India, this role works with project managers, engineers, operations teams, and stakeholders to move requests through defined workflows, maintain accurate records, escalate blockers, and reduce the administrative and coordination workload of existing project managers.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful candidate brings consistency to change requests and ticket follow-up, makes backlog and project status visible, drives overdue actions to closure, and proactively removes administrative burdens from project managers. They communicate clearly, maintain dependable records, and know when technical or management approval is required.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Coordinate the end-to-end administrative change management workflow: intake, categorization, completeness checks, scheduling, approval routing, implementation tracking, and closure.
* Verify that change records contain the required scope, affected assets/sites, impact and risk information, implementation plan, rollback plan, approvals, and post-change evidence; escalate gaps before execution.
* Maintain the change calendar; coordinate planned maintenance windows, customer notifications, implementation owners, and change-status communications across teams.
* Monitor Zendesk and related ticket queues for aging requests, stalled work, missing ownership, overdue follow-ups, and SLA risks; publish actionable backlog reports and trends.
* Drive ticket follow-through by confirming assigned owners, requesting updates, tracking next steps, escalating blockers, and verifying that resolution notes and closure criteria are complete.
* Support existing project managers with project plans, schedules, task assignments, milestones, action items, meeting notes, risk and issue logs, and stakeholder follow-ups.
* Coordinate cross-functional deliverables with OT Engineering, Managed Security Services, cybersecurity, vendors, site personnel, and customer representatives without assuming technical approval authority.
* Maintain accurate project trackers, change logs, ticket dashboards, document repositories, and status reports so stakeholders have a reliable view of priorities and progress.
* Identify recurring causes of missed changes, delayed tickets, and project bottlenecks; recommend practical workflow, ownership, and reporting improvements.
* Develop, document, and maintain standard operating procedures, checklists, and templates for change control, ticket tracking, and project coordination.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Excellent organization and attention to detail while managing high volumes of tickets, changes, milestones, deadlines, and dependencies.
* Ability to run structured follow-up, prioritize competing requests, identify ownership gaps, and escalate material blockers promptly.
* Understanding of change management fundamentals, including approvals, maintenance windows, risk/impact documentation, rollback planning, and closure evidence.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including concise status updates, clear meeting notes, and professional customer and stakeholder interactions.
* Ability to maintain reliable reporting and analyze trends using Excel, ticketing dashboards, and project trackers.
* Comfort learning OT and cybersecurity terminology and collaborating with technical teams without independently making engineering decisions.
* Self-directed problem solving, sound judgment, and a continuous-improvement mindset; able to turn ambiguous work into defined next steps.
* Ability to work effectively with distributed U.S. and Mexico teams, coordinate across time zones, and reliably close out commitments.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATION & EDUCATION**

* At least 6+ years of working experience.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Engineering, Operations, or a related field, or at least 4 years of relevant project coordination, service delivery, or operations experience.
* Experience administering ticket backlogs, change requests, project schedules, or cross-functional workflows; experience in technical service environments preferred.
* Proficiency with Excel and familiarity with Zendesk, Trello, Microsoft 365, or comparable ticketing and project management tools.
* Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken, for coordination with U.S.-based teams and stakeholders.

**Temenos is a global leader in banking technology. Through our market-leading core banking suite and best-in-class composable solutions, we are modernizing the banking industry. Banks of all sizes utilize our adaptable technology – on-premises, in the cloud, or as SaaS – to deliver next-generation services and AI-enhanced experiences that elevate banking for their customers. Our mission is to create a world where people can live their best financial lives.**

  

**VALUES**

  

**Care about transforming the Banking landscape.**

**Commit to being part of an exciting culture and product evolving within the financial industry.**

**Collaborate effectively and proactively with teams within or outside Temenos.**

**Challenge yourself to be ambitious and achieve your individual as well as the company targets.**

  

**About Temenos**
-----------------

Temenos powers a world of banking that creates opportunities for billions of people and businesses everywhere. We have been doing this for over 30 years through the pioneering spirit of our Temenosians who are passionate about making banking better, together.

We serve over 3000 clients from the largest to challengers and community banks in 150+ countries. We collaborate with clients to build new banking services and state-of-the-art customer experiences on our open banking platform, helping them operate more sustainably.

At Temenos, we have an open-minded and inclusive culture, where everyone has the power to create their own destiny and make a positive contribution to the world of banking and society.

**About the Global Delivery Centre (GDC)**
------------------------------------------

The GDC plays a critical role in supporting Temenos’ mission to deliver industry-leading banking software solutions by optimizing the implementation process for our customers. This team is a key part of the Temenos Services organization, responsible for driving efficiency, scalability, and cost-effectiveness in (primarily) global Temenos Transact implementations.

The GDC consists of a talented, diverse team of consultants and engineers who specialize in Temenos software. These personnel deliver a host of well-defined GDC Technical Services.

The technical services delivered by the GDC are well defined, with properly structured estimation models, entry/exit criteria and testing/quality assurance processes.

**About the GDC Project Management (PM) Team**
----------------------------------------------

The PM team consists of a select group of highly qualified personnel performing the role of a Project Manager for the GDC team.

The PM is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of GDC technical services and/or solutions as needed by clients. The PM bridges project management, client engagement, and operational execution, ensuring that all aspects of a GDC engagement align with business goals and client expectations.

A PM serves as the primary point of contact/interface for the GDC team to Temenos regional services and Product team counterparts internally and for client team stakeholders externally (this includes partners where required).

* A PM ensures that the client’s needs are met, fostering trust and long-term relationships.
* They provide insights for continuous improvement to streamline delivery processes, improving productivity and efficiency.
* A PM strives for successful delivery leading to repeat business, referrals, and upselling opportunities for the GDC.

**OPPORTUNITIES**
-----------------

### **Project/Program Management**

Lead teams of diversly skilled GDC personnel through parallelly executed GDC engagements. Understand the defined scope of each engagement to structure proper project plans adhering to engagement goals and agreed timeframes as applicable. Work with the GDC resource management team to ensure that each engagement has the necessary personnel with the right skills to deliver a successful engagement. Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture that motivates the team through difficult situations. Ensure that scope creeps are controlled and accounted through change management processes, schedule and effort variances are to be kept to bare minimum at all times.

### **Progress Tracking and Reporting**

Prepare weekly status report to provide accurate current status snapshots to all stakeholders for each GDC engagement. Ensure that project challenges and risks are properly documented and monitored from the start. Raise timely escalations when needed to unblock critical situations to the correct stakeholders internally and externally. Ensure all information needed to handle inward escalations are collated and made readily available.

### **Demand Monitoring and Forecasting**

A PM must work with regional services teams to create pipeline / forecast and manage demands effectively. Requests to the GDC for delivery of technical and consulting services are properly captured and communicated to the Demand Management function. Projects in pipeline status must be properly accounted for in the bi-weekly demand review and management discussions to ensure proper staffing levels.

### **Continuous Improvement & Process Optimization**

Must use lessons learnt from ongoing engagements to identify opportunities for the continuous improvement function of the GDC to improve process/methodologies/productivity. Contribute to GDC Strategic Initiatives to build new Services for the GDC catalog. Contribute inputs to help eliminate inefficiencies by implementing robust methodologies, processes, and tools that accelerate project timelines and increase overall productivity.

### **Customer Engagement & Quality Assurance:**

Ensure that GDC technical services are delivered with the highest quality standards of quality, while ensuring no schedule or effort variances during execution/delivery. Ensure that GDC deliveries align with customer needs and expectations, this will help foster client trust and build referenceable relationships.

### **Collaboration**

Ensure a conducive environment for GDC personnel on engagements to promote productivity and improve delivery efficiency. Work closely with Regional onshore Temenos Services project managers, and consultants, to continuously align GDC delivery and overall project delivery. Build and maintain good working relationships with Product team stakeholders for efficient coordination and effective communication to deliver solutions to clients.

Facilitate a feedback loop from the GDC to the product team and vice versa based on lessons learned through ongoing engagements.

Conduct GDC outreach programs periodically to ensure that regional services are made aware of GDC delivery capabilities that they can leverage to maximize efficiency.

* Minimum of 14 years of experience in professional services, consulting, or software implementation roles, at least 5 of which are in a project management role
* Strong background in the financial services or banking software industry, preferably with hands-on experience with Temenos Transact or similar enterprise software solutions.
* Proven experience leading offshore and near-shore teams, particularly in driving timebound deliveries in challenging programs.
* Strong delivery background, preferably gained in a project management role for a consulting or engineering organization

### **Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong leadership, people management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire diverse, distributed teams.
* Analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving abilities to anticipate challenges and deliver solutions.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
* The person should have good knowledge on MS Project and should hold an industry standard PM certification (PMP/CPD/Agile).

### **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* A Master's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.

* A firm delivery mindset, customer focus, commitment to results, and high-quality standards are essential.

* Good written and spoken communication skills in English.
Capable of networking to build good working relationships with stakeholders at all levels internally and externally.

The Assistant General Manager (AGM) – Planning & Project Controls is responsible for driving end-to-end planning, scheduling, delay analysis, and cross-functional coordination across pre-construction, construction, and post-construction phases. Acting as a crucial operational anchor between the Head Office, site execution teams, and clients, the AGM Planning ensures baseline compliance, tracks cash flows against project progress, maintains hindrance logs, and safeguards project timelines and financial deliverables.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Pre-Construction & Setup**

* **Contractual Terms & Baseline Alignment:** Coordinate with concerned teams to fulfil all client terms and conditions following Letter of Intent (LOI) or Work Order (WO) issuance, including signing agreements, securing advance payments, and dispatching initial deliverables.
* **Master Planning & Logistics:** Architect master project schedules in consultation with execution teams and obtain client approvals. Finalize site logistics plans and secure client sign-off.
* **Kick-off & Mobilization:** Organize Kick-Off Meetings (KOM), record and circulate Minutes of Meeting (MoM), and track progress to ensure site setup, resources, and manpower are fully operational before handing off routines to site project teams.

**2. Construction Phase & Project Controls**

* **Look-Ahead & Milestone Tracking:** Prepare bi-weekly look-ahead schedules, conduct progress reviews with project managers, and monitor milestone targets against client agreements to proactively catch slippages.
* **Reporting & Escalation Framework:** Collect bi-weekly work-done reports and weekly forecasts from all sites. Report schedule deficits to DGM Projects and escalate critical lapses directly to HO/MD. Issue consolidated Monthly Progress Reports (MPR) to senior management and clients.
* **Delay Mitigation & Hindrance Logs:** Maintain detailed hindrance registers across all site locations to capture accurate delay metrics. Execute schedule recovery plans for minor delays or formulate formal time extension packages with full delay analysis to protect against Liquidated Damages (LD) and penalty clauses.
* **Cash Flow & Financial Progress:** Track cash flow against work done across all projects, pitching actual site execution against projected budget cash flows.
* **Site Quality, Safety & Audits:** Maintain secondary tracking of site safety, quality, and housekeeping alongside site-in-charges to ensure high standards and active oversight from the head office.

**3. Post-Construction & Handover**

* **Quality & Snag Inspection:** Conduct comprehensive quality checks and snag list reviews prior to client handing over. Prepare and enforce handover checklists in coordination with project execution teams.
* **Post-Mortem Analysis:** Analyze variance between baseline schedules and actual execution to evaluate project performance, present historical data for future operational planning, and defend client/architect contractual discussions regarding delay/LD implications.

* **Planning & Scheduling Software:** Hands-on expertise in MS Project (MSP), Primavera P6, Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), and Critical Path Method (CPM).
* **Project Controls & Analytics:** Delay Analysis, Hindrance Register Management, Liquidated Damages (LD) Mitigation, Look-Ahead Scheduling, Cash Flow vs. Work-Done Tracking, and Executive Dashboarding.
* **Operations & Governance:** Site Setup & Mobilization Planning, Logistics Strategy, Pre-construction Contract Compliance, Snagging/Handover Checklists, and Safety/Quality Oversight.

title: Project Cost Controller
description:
1. Job Purpose

The Job location is Almaty, Kazakhstan.

To coordinate with the Proposal & Estimation, Accounts & Finance, Procurement, Sales/Marketing, and Project Execution departments to consolidate project-related commercial and financial information, establish project budgets, monitor actual expenditure, evaluate project profitability, and ensure a structured handover of projects to the execution team.

The role is responsible for developing a standardized project cost control and commercial reporting system to support management in effective project planning, cost monitoring, and profitability analysis.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Project Proposal & Commercial Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Sales/Marketing and Proposal & Estimation teams to obtain project enquiries, quotations, technical and commercial proposals, and order-related information.
* Review approved proposals and consolidate the estimated project cost, selling price, expected revenue, and anticipated profit margin.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to ensure that all commercial and cost-related inputs are available before project handover.
* Prepare a project commercial summary based on the approved proposal and purchase order/contract.

**B. Project Budgeting & Cost Control**

* Develop project budgets based on approved proposals, estimates, and contract values.
* Establish a baseline budget covering material, bought-out items, fabrication, machining, labour, subcontracting, inspection, testing, logistics, and other applicable project costs.
* Track budgeted cost versus actual cost and identify cost variances.
* Monitor project expenditure, commitments, and remaining budget throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare project-wise cost reports highlighting budget, actual expenditure, cost-to-complete, forecast final cost, and expected profitability.
* Identify potential cost overruns and communicate deviations to management for timely corrective action.

**C. Procurement Coordination**

* Coordinate with Procurement to obtain material requisitions, purchase orders, supplier quotations, and procurement cost details.
* Consolidate material and bought-out item costs against the approved project budget.
* Track purchase commitments, material costs, delivery status, and potential cost variations.
* Coordinate with Accounts and Procurement to reconcile purchase orders, supplier invoices, and actual procurement expenditure.

**D. Accounts & Finance Coordination**

* Coordinate with Accounts & Finance to obtain project-wise actual expenditure, supplier invoices, subcontractor costs, labour costs, and other relevant financial information.
* Monitor project revenue, customer invoicing, receipts, outstanding payments, and project-related expenses in coordination with Accounts.
* Reconcile estimated costs with actual booked costs and identify discrepancies.
* Prepare project-wise financial summaries and profitability reports for management review.

**E. Project Handover & Documentation**

* Develop a standardized Project Commercial Handover Format for transferring projects from the Sales/Proposal stage to Project Execution.
* Ensure that all relevant commercial and cost information is consolidated before project handover.
* Coordinate with the Project Manager and execution team to explain the approved budget, cost assumptions, scope of work, commercial commitments, and cost-sensitive items.
* Maintain project-wise records of approved proposals, budgets, purchase orders, cost sheets, and commercial revisions.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of project cost information.

**F. Management Reporting & Profitability Analysis**

* Prepare periodic project cost control reports for the Director and senior management.
* Monitor expected profit, actual profitability, gross margin, and forecast profit for each project.
* Compare the original budget with actual expenditure and forecast final cost.
* Highlight financial risks, unplanned expenditure, scope changes, and opportunities for cost savings.
* Develop and maintain Excel-based dashboards and standardized reporting formats for management decision-making.

3. Project Cost Control Parameters

The candidate should be capable of preparing and maintaining the following project-wise information:

**ParameterDescriptionContract ValueApproved project selling priceBudgeted CostEstimated total project costActual CostCost booked to dateCommitted CostApproved purchase orders and other commitments not yet fully bookedCost to CompleteForecast cost required to finish the projectForecast Final CostExpected total cost at completionExpected ProfitContract value less forecast final costProfit Margin (%)Expected profit as a percentage of contract valueCost VarianceDifference between budgeted and actual/forecast costRevenue & ReceivablesInvoicing, collections, and outstanding customer payments

*Note: The reporting format should clearly distinguish actual costs, committed costs, and forecast costs to avoid double counting.*

4. Educational Qualification

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Additional qualifications or certifications in Finance, Cost Accounting, Project Management, or Commercial Management will be an advantage.
* Candidates with an engineering degree and strong practical experience in project costing, commercial coordination, and financial reporting are preferred.

5. Required Experience

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in project coordination, project cost control, commercial operations, or project financial reporting.
* Experience in the Oil & Gas, heat exchanger manufacturing, pressure vessel, heavy fabrication, or engineering project industry is preferred.
* Practical experience coordinating with Accounts & Finance, Procurement, Proposal & Estimation, Sales/Marketing, and Project Execution teams.
* Experience in project budgeting, cost tracking, variance analysis, and profitability reporting.

6. Technical Skills

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and reporting dashboards.
* Knowledge of project costing, budget monitoring, cost variance analysis, and profit margin calculations.
* Familiarity with ERP/accounting systems and project-wise cost tracking.
* Ability to consolidate information from multiple departments into a single standardized reporting format.
* Good documentation, data analysis, and report preparation skills.

7. Key Competencies

* Strong coordination and communication skills.
* Commercial and financial awareness.
* Analytical and problem-solving ability.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in cost reporting.
* Ability to follow up with multiple departments and obtain timely inputs.
* Ability to present clear, concise reports to senior management.
* Proactive identification of cost overruns and profitability risks.

8. Expected Deliverables

The selected candidate will be expected to establish and maintain:

* Standard Project Commercial Summary Format.
* Project Budget and Cost Breakdown Sheet.
* Budget vs. Actual Cost Monitoring Report.
* Procurement Cost and Commitment Tracking Sheet.
* Project Profitability and Forecast Cost Report.
* Project Commercial Handover Checklist.
* Monthly Project Cost Control Dashboard for Management.

9. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely preparation of project budgets and commercial handover documents.
* Accuracy and completeness of project cost reports.
* Timely identification and reporting of cost variances.
* Timeliness of departmental input collection and cost reconciliation.
* Reliability of forecast final cost and project profitability reports.
* Implementation and consistent use of standardized project cost control formats.

10. Overall Role Objective

To establish a systematic project commercial and cost control process that connects Proposal & Estimation, Accounts & Finance, Procurement, Sales/Marketing, and Project Execution, enabling management to monitor each project's approved budget, actual spending, commitments, forecast cost, revenue, and expected profitability from order receipt through project completion.

**Your IT Future, Delivered.**
==============================

With a global team of 5600+ IT professionals, DHL IT Services **connects people** and keeps the global economy running **by continuously innovating and creating sustainable digital solutions**. We work **beyond global borders** and push boundaries across **all dimensions of logistics**. You can **leave your mark** shaping the **technology backbone** of the biggest logistics company of the world. All our locations have earned the **#GreatPlaceToWork** certification, reflecting our commitment to exceptional employee experience.

**Senior Project Manager**

**Digitalization. Simply delivered.**

At IT Services, we are looking for a Senior Project Manager who combines hands-on software engineering capability with project, product, service, and people leadership. You will lead the delivery, operation, and continuous evolution of enterprise applications and digital products in a global technology environment.

*#DHL #DHLITServices #GreatPlace #SeniorProjectManager #TechnicalDelivery #ProductManagement #ServiceManagement*

**Grow together**

**Senior Project Manager – Project Management, Technical Delivery, Product & Service Management**

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Project Manager with a strong software engineering background to lead the delivery, operation, and continuous evolution of enterprise applications and digital products. This is not a traditional project-management-only position. The successful candidate must remain technically hands-on and be capable of contributing to architecture, solution design, code reviews, technical troubleshooting, and critical production decisions.

The role combines Build and Run accountability with project and product management, service management, project governance, stakeholder engagement, and people leadership. The candidate should be comfortable moving between executive-level communication, delivery planning, engineering discussions, operational reviews, reporting, and team development.

**End-to-End Project & Delivery Management**

* Own delivery of complex technology projects from initiation, discovery, and solution design through build, testing, deployment, hypercare, and transition to operations.
* Define and manage scope, schedule, budget, resource plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, and quality expectations.
* Establish fit-for-purpose governance and provide clear, concise status reporting to business and technology leadership.
* Coordinate delivery across product, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, testing, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Apply Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery approaches based on the needs of the initiative.
* Proactively identify delivery risks, resolve impediments, lead escalations, and drive decisions to closure.
* Manage release readiness, cutover planning, go-live governance, hypercare, and application support.
* Maintain and provide PSR reporting to management.

**Hands-on Technical Leadership (Build)**

* Provide hands-on technical leadership across frontend, backend, API, integration, database, security, deployment, and operational concerns.
* Design, build, and review enterprise applications using Java, Spring Boot, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, REST APIs, microservices, and related technologies.
* Contribute to architecture and solution-design decisions, technical proof-of-concepts, code reviews, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Guide engineering teams on secure coding, design patterns, scalability, resilience, maintainability, testing, and code-quality practices.
* Ensure effective implementation of CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, observability, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive application modernization, cloud-native engineering, reusable components, engineering standards, and technical debt reduction.
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise expectations for security, reliability, performance, compliance, supportability, and cost effectiveness.

**Product Management**

* Partner with business stakeholders to define product vision, outcomes, roadmap, priorities, and value measures.
* Translate business goals and user needs into themes, capabilities, features, epics, and prioritized backlogs.
* Balance business value, customer needs, operational risk, architectural priorities, technical debt, and delivery capacity.
* Facilitate product discovery, requirement clarification, prioritization, release planning, and acceptance decisions.
* Use stakeholder feedback, service insights, usage data, and operational learning to drive continuous product improvement.
* Manage the product lifecycle, including introduction, growth, modernization, consolidation, and retirement where applicable.

**Service Management (Run)**

* Own the reliability, availability, performance, security, and supportability of assigned applications and services.
* Lead or oversee Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Release, Knowledge, Capacity, Availability, and Continuity Management practices.
* Define, monitor, and review SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, service health indicators, operational risks, and improvement actions.
* Lead complex production troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and preventive-action tracking.
* Drive service improvement, automation, monitoring, alerting, observability, resilience, disaster-recovery readiness, and reduction of recurring incidents.
* Coordinate with application support, infrastructure, cloud/platform, security, database, network, and vendor teams.
* Ensure smooth transition of new or changed solutions into production support with clear ownership, documentation, and support models.

**Team & People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop multidisciplinary teams consisting of engineers, analysts, testers, support specialists, and project contributors.
* Set clear objectives, delivery expectations, accountabilities, and ways of working.
* Build team capability through mentoring, technical guidance, knowledge sharing, feedback, and development planning.
* Support workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, succession planning, skills development, and capacity management.
* Promote a culture of collaboration, engineering excellence, ownership, transparency, inclusion, continuous improvement, and timely escalation.
* Manage globally distributed internal and external teams and create effective collaboration across locations and time zones.

**Stakeholder, Financial & Vendor Management**

* Act as a trusted technology partner for business, product, architecture, engineering, operations, and senior leadership stakeholders.
* Communicate complex technical and delivery topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Prepare decision papers, delivery updates, risk summaries, roadmap views, forecasts, and executive presentations.
* Manage project and service budgets, forecasts, resource utilization, commercial commitments, and cost optimization.
* Manage vendors and external partners through clear deliverables, quality expectations, service levels, governance, and performance follow-up.
* Facilitate decision-making, resolve cross-functional conflicts, and maintain alignment on priorities and outcomes.

**Ready to embark on the journey? Here’s what we are looking for:**

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 10-15 years of progressive experience across software engineering, technical delivery, project management, product delivery, or application/service management.
* Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional technology projects and enterprise application delivery.

**Technical Competencies**

* Strong hands-on programming experience in Java and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, including relevant frameworks such as Spring Boot, Node.js, and React.
* Proven experience designing, building, integrating, deploying, and supporting end-to-end enterprise-scale applications.
* Demonstrated experience with both Build and Run responsibilities for business-critical or mission-critical applications.
* Experience with product roadmaps, backlog prioritization, lifecycle management, and value-driven delivery.
* Strong knowledge of project/program management, Agile delivery, SDLC, DevOps/DevSecOps, and IT service management principles.
* Experience leading technical teams, developing people, managing capacity, and coordinating globally distributed stakeholders and delivery partners.
* Experience using project management and delivery tools such as Jira.
* Practical experience working in Agile and Scrum delivery environments.
* Good knowledge of IT infrastructure, including cloud platforms, networks, servers, databases, security, and deployment environments.
* Project management certification, such as PMP or PRINCE2.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience delivering and operating mission-critical, customer-facing, or revenue-impacting applications.
* Experience with cloud-native development, OpenShift/Kubernetes, CI/CD platforms, infrastructure as code, and observability solutions.
* Experience in application modernization, legacy transformation, platform migration, system integration, and large-scale change.
* Experience managing external suppliers, outsourced delivery teams, and multi-vendor environments.
* Experience working in a global enterprise environment with distributed teams and complex stakeholder structures.
* Relevant certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum/SAFe, Product Owner/Product Management, ITIL, Java, AWS, Azure, or GCP.

**Core Competencies**

* Hands-on technical credibility and engineering leadership
* End-to-end ownership and outcome orientation
* Project and program delivery discipline
* Product thinking and customer focus
* Service reliability and operational excellence
* People leadership, coaching, and capability building
* Strategic planning with strong execution focus
* Risk management and sound decision-making
* Stakeholder influence and executive communication
* Collaboration across business, technology, and vendors

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication, negotiation, facilitation, problem-solving, decision-making, and executive stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize, and organize tasks under time and workload pressure.
* Advanced spoken and written English for effective cross-region collaboration in a multinational environment.
* Strategic mindset with a hands-on approach to problem-solving and innovation.
* Proactive, detail-oriented, and effective in cross-functional team environments.

**An array of benefits for you:**

* + Hybrid work arrangements to balance in-office collaboration and home flexibility.
* + Annual Leave: 42 days off apart from Public / National Holidays.
* + Medical Insurance: Self + Spouse + 2 children. An option to opt for Voluntary Parental Insurance (Parents / Parent -in-laws) at a nominal premium covering pre existing disease.
* + In House training programs: professional and technical training certifications.

title: Junior Project Coordinator
description:
Junior Project Coordinator

Hexr Factory is a next-generation immersive technology company and an Unreal Engine Authorized Service Partner — redefining how businesses and teams turn ideas into reality through powerful, real-time digital experiences.

We don’t just build products — we engineer dynamic, interactive ecosystems that transform complex concepts into compelling, high-impact solutions. From cutting-edge digital twins and advanced simulations to fully interactive platforms, our work enables sectors such as AEC, real estate, automotive, edtech and enterprise to visualise, communicate and operate with exceptional clarity and accuracy.

At Hexr, innovation is at the core of everything we do. Our multidisciplinary team blends deep interactive realtime 3D expertise with leading-edge software engineering, design thinking and high-fidelity visualization to deliver visually striking, technically robust experiences across web, desktop and mobile environments.

This is a place for ambitious thinkers and problem-solvers — people who want to push boundaries, build meaningful technology and create experiences that don’t just look good, but truly make an impact.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Project Coordinator with 1–3 years of relevant experience to support the day-to-day execution of cross-functional projects. The role is focused on keeping work organised, maintaining accurate project information, coordinating reviews and handovers, and helping leads identify risks early. This is a hands-on coordination role, not a Project Manager position.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain project plans and trackers with clear tasks, owners, priorities, due dates, dependencies and current status.
* Follow up on progress and verify updates against available files, versions, review comments or approvals before reporting completion.
* Coordinate daily stand-ups, reviews and internal checkpoints; record decisions, actions, blockers and unresolved questions.
* Convert requirements and feedback from meetings, email and chat into clear, trackable actions.
* Monitor deadlines and dependencies, flag risks early, and communicate the likely impact and required decision to the relevant lead.
* Prepare concise project updates covering confirmed progress, at-risk items, blockers and decisions required.
* Maintain meeting notes, action logs, change records and other project documentation in the agreed source of truth.
* Coordinate handovers between teams only after required review, approval, version and file-link checks are complete.
* Support resource and capacity visibility, including planned leave and competing priorities, while working with project leads on practical schedule changes.
* Help improve tracking, reporting and follow-up routines using spreadsheets, project tools, automation or carefully verified AI assistance.
* Handle client and internal project information with discretion and confidentiality.

Required Skills and Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in project coordination, production coordination, PMO support or a comparable delivery-focused role.
* Practical experience using spreadsheets and at least one project or task-management tool.
* Working knowledge of task planning, dependencies, risks, status reporting, reviews, approvals and handovers.
* Clear written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
* Ability to work with creative and technical teams, ask precise questions and escalate issues with useful context.
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience is acceptable. An MBA or project-management certification is welcome but not required.
* Familiarity with Agile or Scrum routines and basic reporting or automation workflows is an advantage.

title: Interior Project Manager
description:
Role Overview

The Interior Project Manager will be responsible for the **end\-to\-end execution of assigned interior projects**, ensuring that projects are delivered within the agreed **scope, timeline, budget and quality standards**.

The role involves close coordination between the **Design Team, Project Engineering Team, Factory/Manufacturing Team, vendors, contractors, suppliers and clients**.

The ideal candidate should be highly organised, technically strong, proactive in problem\-solving and comfortable taking ownership of multiple moving parts on an interior project.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Project Planning \& Execution

* Take complete ownership of assigned interior projects from design handover to final completion.
* Review the approved design, drawings, BOQ, scope of work, specifications and project requirements before execution.
* Prepare and maintain project execution schedules and milestones.
* Break down projects into activity\-wise execution plans and monitor progress against timelines.
* Coordinate dependencies between civil, electrical, carpentry, modular furniture, painting, false ceiling, flooring, plumbing and other trades.
* Identify potential execution bottlenecks in advance and take corrective action.
* Ensure projects progress according to the approved sequence and schedule.

2\. Site Management

* Conduct regular site visits and monitor day\-to\-day execution.
* Coordinate with site labour/contractors.
* Ensure site activities are executed as per approved drawings and specifications.
* Verify dimensions, levels, alignment, installation and workmanship.
* Coordinate site readiness before commencement of each activity.
* Ensure proper protection of completed works and materials at site.
* Maintain site discipline, cleanliness and safe working practices.

3\. Design \& Technical Coordination

* Review drawings and designs before execution and identify technical or site\-related issues.
* Coordinate with the Design Team to resolve design clarifications and site constraints.
* Ensure that no deviation from approved drawings is executed without appropriate approval.
* Coordinate site measurements and verify critical dimensions before manufacturing or installation.
* Ensure coordination between 2D drawings, 3D designs, BOQ, cutlists and actual site conditions.
* Identify design\-to\-execution gaps and communicate them proactively to the relevant team.

4\. Vendor \& Contractor Management

* Coordinate and manage contractors, installers, fabricators and specialised vendors.
* Allocate work and establish expected completion timelines.
* Monitor contractor performance, productivity and workmanship.
* Ensure vendors adhere to Antara Haus quality and execution standards.
* Coordinate material delivery, installation and rectification activities.
* Track pending works and ensure timely closure.
* Escalate persistent vendor performance or quality issues.

5\. Procurement \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate sourcing of required materials to ensure availability as per project schedule.
* Prepare and communicate material requirements sufficiently in advance.
* Track material orders, expected delivery dates and site requirements.
* Verify received materials against specifications and quantities where required.
* Identify material shortages, damages or specification mismatches immediately.
* Coordinate urgent procurement requirements to prevent project delays.
* Ensure materials are properly stored and handled at site.

6\. Quality Control

* Maintain high standards of workmanship across all project activities.
* Conduct regular quality inspections at critical stages.
* Check dimensions, alignment, finish, detailing, installation and functionality.
* Ensure modular furniture and site works meet approved design specifications.
* Identify defects and coordinate rectification with the responsible contractor/vendor.
* Maintain snag lists and track closure of all observations.
* Conduct pre\-handover quality inspections and ensure all punch\-list items are closed.

7\. Client Coordination

* Act as the primary project execution point of contact for the client where required.
* Communicate project progress, upcoming activities and site requirements clearly.
* Coordinate client approvals required for execution.
* Manage expectations regarding timelines, site conditions and execution requirements.
* Escalate design changes, scope changes and potential cost/time impacts to management before committing.
* Ensure client concerns are recorded, assigned and closed systematically.
* Maintain a professional and solution\-oriented relationship with clients.

8\. Project Cost \& Scope Control

* Ensure execution remains within the approved project scope and BOQ.
* Identify additional works, variations and scope changes before execution.
* Obtain appropriate approval for changes before committing resources or costs.
* Monitor material wastage and avoid unnecessary rework.
* Coordinate with the management/accounts team regarding project\-related commercial matters where required.
* Highlight potential cost overruns or commercial risks at an early stage.

9\. Project Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain accurate project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure all project tasks and follow\-ups are recorded in the company's task management system.
* Maintain project schedules, site reports, material requirements, snag lists and progress updates.
* Submit regular project status reports covering:
* Work completed
* Work in progress
* Planned activities
* Labour/contractor status
* Material availability
* Material requirements
* Delays and risks
* Client dependencies
* Quality issues
* Decisions/approvals required
* Ensure project information is current and accessible to the relevant internal teams.

10\. Project Handover

* Coordinate final project completion and snag closure.
* Conduct final quality checks before client handover.
* Ensure all installations, hardware, appliances, lighting and furniture are functional.
* Coordinate cleaning and final site preparation.
* Ensure project documentation and relevant warranties/manuals are collected where applicable.
* Obtain project completion and client handover confirmation.
* Coordinate post\-handover rectification during the applicable defect\-liability period.
